name_zh: 白先勇/龙应台/陈芳明：离散叙事书写与乡愁现代性
name_en: Pai Hsien-yung/Lung Ying-tai/Chen Fang-ming: Diasporic Narrative Writing & Nostalgic Modernity
description_zh: 白先勇 (1937-) 《台北人》以文言/白话夹叙，重构大陆移民在台精英群像的"故园"记忆，奠基华语离散文学；龙应台 (1952-) 《大江大海一九四九》口述史访谈 200+ 位两岸受难者，以"大历史中的小人物"叙事伦理重塑跨海峡共同记忆；陈芳明 (1958-) 《台湾新文学史》建构台湾文学自主谱系，提出"乡愁不是回不去的过去，而是回不去的未来"。三人跨小说/散文/批评，共同体现 M165 离散叙事书写——以"记忆导航+多声部口述+谱系建构"三重技法，在政治分裂中重构文化连续性。
description_en: Pai Hsien-yung (1937-) 'Taipei People' in classical/vernacular mix reconstructs mainland emigre elite's 'lost garden' memory, founding Sinophone diasporic literature; Lung Ying-tai (1952-) 'Big River Big Sea 1949' oral history interviews 200+ cross-strait victims, 'small figures in big history' narrative ethics reconstructs cross-strait shared memory; Chen Fang-ming (1958-) 'History of Taiwan New Literature' constructs autonomous Taiwan literary genealogy, proposes 'nostalgia is not the unreachable past but the unreachable future'. Across fiction/essay/criticism, all three exemplify M165 Diasporic Narrative Writing—triple technique of 'memory navigation + multi-voiced oral history + genealogical construction' reconstructing cultural continuity amid political division.
reason_zh: 台湾文学非单纯本土书写，而是"大陆记忆+本土生长+国际视野"三重张力场域。白先勇重构精英记忆，龙应台发掘底层受难，陈芳明建构学科谱系。M165 区隔于 M155 魔幻现实(拉美)、M154 梦境时间(澳洲)，核心在于"政治分裂语境下的文化连续性重构"。
reason_en: Taiwan literature not mere native writing but triple tension field of 'mainland memory + native growth + international vision'. Pai reconstructs elite memory, Lung excavates grassroots suffering, Chen constructs disciplinary genealogy. M165 distinct from M155 Magical Realism (Latin America) and M154 Dreamtime Navigation (Australia), core: 'cultural continuity reconstruction under political division context'.
steps_zh: 记忆导航与故园重构：白先勇《台北人》文言白话夹叙，重构大陆精英"故园"空间感
多声部口述历史伦理：龙应台访谈 200+ 受难者，"大历史中的小人物"叙事赋予边缘声音尊严
学科谱系建构与自主性：陈芳明《台湾新文学史》确立台湾文学自主标准，摆脱"中国文学分支"定位
跨海峡/跨代际对话：白先勇晚年返京/龙应台两岸巡讲/陈芳明两岸学术对话，记忆流动重塑共同体
乡愁现代性转向：从"回不去的过去"转向"回不去的未来"，记忆成为面向未来的批判资源
steps_en: Memory navigation & lost garden reconstruction: Pai's 'Taipei People' classical/vernacular mix reconstructs mainland elite 'lost garden' spatial sense
Multi-voiced oral history ethics: Lung interviews 200+ victims, 'small figures in big history' narrative grants dignity to marginal voices
Disciplinary genealogy construction & autonomy: Chen's 'History of Taiwan New Literature' establishes Taiwan literature autonomous criteria, shedding 'branch of Chinese literature' label
Cross-strait/intergenerational dialogue: Pai late return to Beijing / Lung cross-strait lectures / Chen cross-strait academic dialogue, memory fluidity reconstructs community
Nostalgic modernity pivot: from 'unreturnable past' to 'unreturnable future', memory becomes future-oriented critical resource
expected_zh: 分裂社会中以"记忆导航+口述伦理+谱系建构"三重技法，将政治创伤转化为文化批判资源，构建跨越海峡/代际的文学共同体。
expected_en: In divided society, triple technique of 'memory navigation + oral ethics + genealogical construction' converts political trauma into cultural critical resource, constructing literary community across strait/generations.
case_zh: 《台北人》中文经典地位/《大江大海》两岸畅销百万册/《台湾新文学史》成学科教材标准，三人合力确立台湾文学国际话语权。
case_en: 'Taipei People' Chinese classic status / 'Big River Big Sea' cross-strait million-copy bestseller / 'History of Taiwan New Literature' disciplinary textbook standard, trio jointly established Taiwan literature international discourse power.
cross_cultural_impact: Sinophone literature framework; Hong Kong/Chinese diaspora reference; memory studies in divided societies
diaspora_influence: Taiwanese-American literary circles; global Sinophone studies network
indigenous_knowledge_system: Indigenous Taiwanese oral literature influence on nativist movement (limited)
